Package com.sca4d.core.api.setting

Class Setting<T>

java.lang.Object
com.sca4d.core.api.setting.Setting<T>
Direct Known Subclasses:
WritableSetting
public class Setting<T> extends Object
直接读取一项类型化设置，按构造声明选择所属、版本 Codec、继承及覆盖规则。
